No provider-specific planner or bridge requirements resolver. Preserve callback cardinality. Unsupported adapters remain unsupported rather than using fabricated capabilities.

Tests to add before implementation: Actual adapter-boundary integration where available; upload batches; message edits; real provider IDs; partial failures; existing thread identity; ordinary text parity; Telegram absent-metadata behavior.

Action reuse assessment: Extend JidoChatBridge existing transport functions and AdapterOptions/DeliveryResult; adapter owns HTTP/provider details. No new Action and no parallel send path.

Consumers/execution: preserve existing Agent/Engine/Channel service boundaries; plan and prepared content never cross to Engine. Tool selection has no delivery side effect. Transport failures are reported without automatic retries.

Planning only in feat/delivery_plan; do not implement until the proposed migration is reviewed. Policies: AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/documentation.md; relevant service guides before affected work. Existing test behavior changes require specific approval; none granted by this plan. Mocking plan: keep internal boundaries real; isolate external transport/LLM APIs and inject runtime config without global mutations. Documentation: update module contracts and relevant owning service guide with implemented behavior, not duplicate policies. Validation follows authoritative workflow timing.
